topic: Issue of Shares at Premium with Pro-Rata Allotment & Forfeiture
question: Modern Toys Ltd. issued 40,000 equity shares of ₹10 each at a premium of ₹2 per share payable: ₹3 on Application, ₹5 on Allotment (including premium), and balance ₹4 on First & Final Call. Applications were received for 60,000 shares. 10,000 rejected, pro-rata to remaining 50,000. Mohan (allotted 800 shares) failed to pay allotment and call. Shares forfeited and re-issued @ ₹9 fully paid. Pass Journal Entries.
solution_steps: 2. Application money paid: 1,000 × ₹3 = ₹3,000. Required: 800 × ₹3 = ₹2,400. Excess = ₹600.
3. Allotment due: 800 × ₹5 = ₹4,000. Unpaid allotment: ₹4,000 − ₹600 = ₹3,400 (Calls in Arrears).
4. First & Final Call arrears: 800 × ₹4 = ₹3,200. Total arrears = ₹6,600.
5. Share Forfeiture Credit: 800 × ₹3 + ₹600 = ₹3,000.
6. Re-issue: Bank Dr (800 × ₹9 = ₹7,200), Forfeiture Dr (800 × ₹1 = ₹800) to Share Capital ₹8,000.
7. Capital Reserve Transfer: ₹3,000 − ₹800 = ₹2,200.
working_notes: Securities premium was not received on Mohan shares; hence Securities Premium Account is debited upon forfeiture.

journal_entries.particulars:
Equity Share Application A/c ........................................... Dr.
    To Equity Share Capital A/c (40,000 × ₹3)
    To Equity Share Allotment A/c (Advance)
    To Bank A/c (10,000 rejected × ₹3)

Equity Share Capital A/c (800 × ₹10) .............................. Dr.
Securities Premium A/c (800 × ₹2) ............................. Dr.
    To Calls in Arrears A/c (₹3,400 + ₹3,200)
    To Share Forfeiture A/c

Share Forfeiture A/c ...................................................... Dr.
    To Capital Reserve A/c
(Being gain on re-issue transferred)
